task_description: Implement 6 features: PWA manifest, Organigramme, Documents, Self-service portal, Leave approval workflow, and Notifications system

verification.summary: npx next build succeeds (exit 0). Only pre-existing prerender error on /employees/new due to missing Supabase env vars in sandbox. All new pages compile cleanly. No type errors.

issues_addressed: Issue 1: Notifications scoped by employee_id query param; bell reads from localStorage
Issue 2: Leave approval uses single batch insert (atomic) instead of loop-per-row
Issue 3: Approvals page passes approved_by from localStorage-based simulated login
Issue 4: Added migration 028 with CHECK constraint (file_size <= 2MB) and index on employee_id
Issue 5: Service worker excludes /api/ and /_next/ paths from cache
Issue 6: Notification creation made non-blocking with .catch() + console.warn
Issue 7: Organigramme fetches inactive managers as ghost nodes to preserve hierarchy
Issue 1: /notifications/page.tsx now reads employee_id from localStorage and passes it to API (same pattern as bell); markAllAsRead sends employee_id so it only affects that employee
Issue 2: /self-service/leave-request/page.tsx changed await createNotification to fire-and-forget with .catch() so notification failure does not block success state
Issue 3: Migration 028 now also adds chk_file_base64_length CHECK (length(file_base64) <= 3700000) to guard against oversized payloads regardless of file_size metadata
